title: Felt & Static
prompt: aphex twin style from the druqks album
description: A slow, intimate piece that begins as pure ambient texture — long sine-wave pads and pink noise drifting under sparse, reverb-soaked piano notes — before a soft 606 groove quietly assembles beneath. The arrangement builds to a mid-section of layered piano runs and brushed drums, then retreats back into drifting tones and silence.
